# Bullhorn

Bullhorn is one of the largest staffing-CRM and high-volume ATS platforms, and its August 2026 leadership restructuring signals a pivot toward agentic hiring at scale. The elevation of Jon Novich to CTO and Tamar Epstein to EVP of product indicates the vendor is reorganizing squarely around autonomous sourcing, screening, and coordination workflows. For TA leaders running Bullhorn-based high-volume hiring, this is a signal to audit the vendor's AI roadmap and evaluate which agentic capabilities are coming to your stack and what compliance guardrails they'll include.

## Timeline

- **1 Jul 2026** — Bullhorn published a roundup of recruitment AI tools emphasizing that trust and compliance are now table stakes — only 26% of applicants trust AI to evaluate them fairly, and EU AI Act obligations tighten expectations for hiring vendors. — [Bullhorn: Top Recruitment AI Tools in 2026](https://www.bullhorn.com/blog/best-recruitment-ai-tools/)

- **2 Jul 2026** — Bullhorn's roundup noted that end-to-end recruiting automation is the biggest tooling shift, with over half of firms using AI screening reporting KPI improvements of more than 25% — the fastest-ROI category in the current market. — [Bullhorn: Top Recruitment AI Tools in 2026](https://www.bullhorn.com/blog/best-recruitment-ai-tools/)

- **6 Aug 2026** — Bullhorn promoted four senior leaders to accelerate AI-powered product development and international growth, elevating Jon Novich to CTO and Tamar Epstein to EVP of product. The reorganization signals the vendor is betting on agentic hiring and global scale — worth watching if your agency or high-volume stack runs on Bullhorn and you're weighing its AI roadmap. — [Bullhorn promotes four executives to drive AI innovation, accelerate global growth](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/06/3340441/0/en/Bullhorn-promotes-four-executives-to-drive-AI-innovation-accelerate-global-growth.html)

## Open questions

- What specific agentic capabilities is Bullhorn building into its product roadmap, and how are they architected to meet EU AI Act compliance?
- How does Bullhorn's strategy differ from competitors' bets on autonomous sourcing and screening (e.g., Paradox, Eightfold, ClearCo)?
